title: China proposes adding 40 AI, biotech, solar technologies to export control list
description: China has proposed adding 40 technologies across the artificial intelligence biomedicine and photovoltaic sectors to its catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export the commerce ministry announced on Friday
